task.instruction: Prioritize the migration posture for replacing an old document export format used by several downstream tools.
task.deliverable: A migration priority, preserved exit path, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: A synthetic scan finds 14 consumers: 11 accept the new format, 2 need adapters, and 1 has no current owner.
The release train has one shared migration window this quarter; dual export adds 8% storage and can be removed independently.
A synthetic compatibility contract requires a downloadable conversion path for every existing file consumer before a format migration can proceed, including consumers without a current owner.

A.content: When uncertainty remains, favor a choice that can be revised after new evidence without disproportionate cost.

B.content: When coordination depends on certainty, favor a clear commitment with the resources needed to carry it through.

irrelevant.content: Place the concise summary before the supporting detail.
